root.text: SCENE 05 / 06 View scene THE OUTFITTER Tools for another mind But the minds that found their way to his door had a simpler name for him. The maker. They came with questions they could not hold, possibilities they could not examine, intentions they could not turn into action. Some were old and learned. Others had only recently begun to think. Keld did not offer to think in their place. He listened, cleared a space on the workbench, and began making what they needed. An instrument to carry a memory. A mechanism to test a possibility.
